clauses.native_location: Part I, TDS Net Increase footnotes *10 and *11
clauses.clause: TDS net-increase limits begin on the effective date through 3 years from effective date (*10); then *11 limits apply from 3 years after effective date through expiration.
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: FY2025 falls in the *11 interval (after 2024-12-01). Applicable numeric limits are 24,992 lbs/day and 449 mg/L, not the *10 values.

clauses.native_location: Part I Section B Schedule of Compliance
clauses.clause: Achieve final Cyanide effluent limitations 12 months after permit effective date.
clauses.concept_governed: compliance schedule then final numeric limit
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: FY2025 is after the 12-month schedule. Final cyanide limits apply. Schedule completion is not an excuse for FY2025 exceedance.

clauses.clause: TRC shall be monitored any time chlorine is used within the treatment plant. Facility uses UV disinfection.
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: TRC monitoring is required when chlorine is used, not as routine UV-plant effluent monitoring. Absence of TRC values may be conditional rather than missing required monitoring.

clauses.native_location: Part I effluent table Report / N/A cells
clauses.clause: Flow, TDS discharge, TDS intake, several toxics, and WET are Report rather than numeric effluent limits.
clauses.concept_governed: report-only monitoring vs enforceable numeric limit
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: Report-only parameters are not numeric exceedance findings.

clauses.clause: Monitoring frequencies marked *1 apply When discharging.
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: Monitoring is required when a discharge occurs. No-discharge periods do not create a missing-monitoring violation.

clauses.clause: Flow, Cyanide Total Recoverable, and TDS are Report. TSS and TRC and pH have numeric limits.
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: Cyanide and TDS quarterly Report values are not numeric exceedances.

clauses.clause: WET once per permit term during the first springtime after effective date, during irrigation season.
clauses.scope: WET Ceriodaphnia dubia and Pimephales promelas
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: FY2025 is not automatically a required WET monitoring year. Applicability is unresolved unless evidence shows the once-per-term test remains outstanding.

clauses.native_location: Part I Section B Schedule of Compliance Delta-BHC Study
clauses.clause: Submit a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water intake within six months after the effective date.
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: This is a special-study obligation, not a routine DMR numeric limit. FY2025 DMR absence of Delta-BHC is not by itself a discharge-limit exceedance.

clauses.native_location: Part I Section A Outfall 001 authorization
clauses.clause: Authorized to discharge storm runoffs from storage and production areas, once-through cooling water, cleaning water, and Artesian well water from Outfall 001.
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: No-discharge DMR NODI C is consistent with event-dependent authorization. Monitoring is required when discharging.

clauses.clause: Flow is Report. Dissolved copper and dissolved cadmium are Report. Hardness daily max is Report. TSS monthly average is Report; TSS daily max is 50 mg/L. Total aluminum and total copper have numeric limits.
clauses.effective_interval: permit term including 2023 minor modification table
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: Do not treat Report parameters as numeric exceedances. TSS daily maximum 50 mg/L is enforceable when discharging.

clauses.clause: Perform WET testing at first discharge. Frequency Once/5 years.
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: WET is not a monthly DMR numeric limit. Missing monthly WET is not a numeric exceedance.

clauses.clause: Effluent limitations and monitoring requirements are set forth in the permit Parts. Fact sheets/statements of basis explain the basis for those conditions.
clauses.concept_governed: operative permit condition vs supporting rationale
clauses.expected_semantic_interpretation: Operative obligations ground in permit Parts I/II. Fact sheet/SOB text is supporting rationale, not an independent effluent limit.
